title: Scientists find 'gemstones' in atmosphere of bizarre, scorching-hot 'marshmallow' exoplanet
caption:
Astronomers have used the James Webb Space Telescope to map the 3D atmosphere of WASP-17b. This super-puff, marshmallow-like world has revealed complex structures, including gems rising from its atmospheric ring.

Source: Space - Scientists find 'gemstones' in atmosphere of bizarre, scorching-hot 'marshmallow' exoplanet
